content.short: Scroll is a native zkEVM Layer 2 network developed to scale Ethereum with full bytecode-level compatibility.
content.description: Scroll is a leading developer-ready Layer 2 scaling solution for Ethereum, powered by Zero-Knowledge Ethereum Virtual Machine (zkEVM) technology. Designed to provide a seamless transition for existing dApps, Scroll offers full bytecode-level compatibility, allowing developers to deploy Ethereum-based smart contracts with zero code modifications. By utilizing advanced ZK-rollups, the network achieves high throughput and significantly lower transaction costs while inheriting Ethereum's security. Scroll supports a vibrant ecosystem of DeFi, gaming, and social applications globally.
content.meta: Scroll is a zkEVM Layer 2 network providing scalable and secure infrastructure for Ethereum. Discover Scroll and more on the Lancers Web3 Explorer.
